sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Heading out on patrol towards Darby Street and Elliott Street.
Darby Street and Elliott Street, including the Wilson Carpark, all clear. Heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Wellesley Street all clear; continuing on Federal Street.
Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's about a vagrant sleeping in the store and refusing to leave. Heading to the location.

Arrived at Queen Street McDonald's and saw a male vagrant with sticks and a metal pole at the bus stop. We went inside to remove the vagrant, only to be told the individual outside at the bus stop was the one reported. We approached and trespassed the individual on behalf of McDonald's; he boarded the bus and left for Karangahape Road. Standing by for security presence.
High Street all clear; continuing on O'Connell Street to check on Chancery Square.
Freyberg Square, O'Connell Street and Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Shortland Minimart and Haven Mart; no issues to report. Continuing patrol to check on Fort Street.
Welfare check on Fort Lane, Right Track, Jo & Joes, White Lady, 77 Convenience Store and the Wilson Carpark, all clear. Continuing towards Gore Street.
Welfare check on Tribe, Auckland Harbour Suites and Sol, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks on 77 Convenience Store Customs Street, Coffee Club and Custom Mart. Heading to check on McDonald's Britomart.
Welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear. Checking in on TK Square and Commercial Bay.
All clear; standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Lower Albert Street.
Countdown and Aotea Square all clear. Heading up towards Albert Street.
Albert Mart all clear. Standing by for security presence due to this being a hotspot area.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham Street; commencing welfare checks on the surrounding businesses.
Welfare check on Hollywood Cafe, Shakespeare Tavern and Good To Go Supermarket, all clear. Heading to check in on St Patrick's Cathedral.
St Patrick's Square and the Cathedral all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Continuing onto Albert Street towards Wellesley Street.
Arrived on Wellesley Street and heading down towards Woolworths for the check-in.
Welfare check on Liquor City, Mr Katsu and Woolworths, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to Queen Street to go towards Aotea Square.
Received a call from Kathmandu regarding a group that tried to have a fight inside the store. Heading there now.
Arrived at the store and being debriefed on the situation.
One Caucasian male had come behind the till and, when confronted, became aggressive and started swearing at the staff member.

One of the individual's friends became aggressive and tried to fight a civilian bystander. (Photo on file.) We broke them apart and separated the two parties. The individual continued to be aggressive; standing by for security presence and maintaining surveillance.
The individual is heading in the direction of the person he tried to fight; keeping distance and maintaining visuals.
The individual is gone. Heading back to Kathmandu to retrieve the photo.

Arrived back at Kathmandu and retrieved the photo. Police were there as well and we informed them about the male who had been trying to fight. Standing by for security presence. Fire trucks noted outside Specsavers and OPSM. (Photo on file.)
Vagrant observed walking and behaving erratically. (Photo on file.)
The individual entered Farmers; stood by until he left. Heading to the office.

Welfare check on the stores from Starbucks up to Acceco and NZ; all businesses clear. Young kids on e-bikes and scooters in the area. (Photo on file.) Standing by for public safety around the e-scooter kids before heading towards Aotea Square.
Received a call from Cosmetic Clinic about a male vagrant smoking cannabis and being rude.

Spoke to the individual and he left, mumbling under his breath, but otherwise no issues. (Photo of the individual on file — taken from behind to avoid provoking aggression.) Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Q Convenience Store about a male being aggressive, kicking an e-scooter down and forcing people to give him money.
Received a call from Swarovski in regards to the same individual. Heading to the location.

We arrived and Police arrived at the same time; the person was given one verbal warning — any further public disturbance and he will be arrested. (Photo on file.) Standing by for security presence and ensuring he leaves.
Kids on e-scooters again; Police gave them a telling-off for riding on the main road through a red light and interrupting traffic. Continuing to stand by.
Male observed being very antisocial and erratic outside Farmers; appears to possibly be mentally unstable.
Standing by for shift changeover and completing Auror reports.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:23)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Standing by for the second guard.
Guard has arrived on site; having a debrief before commencing patrols.
Charging the Ops Phone, which is on 3% (standing by 15:45).
Welfare checks, all clear; patrolling up Wellesley Street:
Wellesley Street all clear, no issues; patrolling Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Lorne Street staircase mural centre, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of the whole of Lorne Street; welfare check on all businesses open, all clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; large crowd present due to performers. Commencing a sweep (16:23–16:35).
Full sweep of Freyberg Place and Chancery Square; welfare checks along O'Connell Street, Chancery Street and all businesses open in the area, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear; continuing route.
Full sweep of High Street with welfare checks on all businesses in the area, all clear.
Full sweep of Shortland Street; welfare check at Short Mart, North Face, Haven Mart and Taco Bell, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check along Queen Street, all clear, no issues. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep.

Received a response call from The Right Track sports cafe regarding a male individual causing a disturbance inside the premises; we were told the individual had already left. Heading to the location to retrieve footage.
Arrived at the response location; getting briefed.

We were told the vagrant who wears the Knights clothing had been aggressive and was accusing the manager of pocketing his winnings. Went to the back to retrieve footage and were asked to trespass him and issue a lifetime ban. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Albert Mart in regards to a person who stole from the store 10 minutes earlier. The staff member has no photo of the person and cannot describe them. Heading over to assist.

Received a call from Lovisa regarding a female individual who stole jewellery from their store — described as Maori with a green Woolworths bag, direction of travel unknown. Heading towards Lovisa as the call most likely to be resolved.
Received another call about a female individual who stole jewellery from their store; appears to be the same individual. Heading there now.

Arrived at Lovisa and asked for footage, but they cannot access it and are closing soon. They asked that we trespass her if we find her; we explained that if we find the individual we will also try to recover the stolen items and hold them until tomorrow.
Received a call from Cotton On about an intoxicated female; she had left the store and no items were taken.
Arrived; the person who had taken a photo sent us the photos of the two individuals. (Photos on file.) We will patrol up Queen Street to try to spot them, checking stores as well.
While standing by at the corner of Wellesley Street and Queen Street, observed a member of the public and a male vagrant having an aggressive verbal exchange. Heading over to resolve the issue.

We were notified that the vagrant had spat at and threatened to harm the member of the public, and accused him of following him around. The member of the public was on the phone to Police; we approached the vagrant about the situation and asked him to stay put until Police arrived so the matter could be resolved civilly. He complied. (Photo on file.)
Police have arrived on scene; standing by for security presence.
Police took statements from both parties and from us, and had both parties walk in different directions to ensure no further issues. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to a call from Woolworths in regards to a male vagrant begging outside the premises.

Removed the individual and issued a trespass notice on him for The Right Track — the same individual the manager had asked us to trespass and ban. He complied but tried to give us his side of the story. Another vagrant then approached and spoke to us, rambling about Michael Jackson, psychiatric hospitals and doctors; we deemed him no harm, just somewhat unstable. He explained he was on medication and not violent, and after we advised we needed to continue with our job he bid us farewell and left. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Elliott Stables to check in on the guard (on site 19:35–19:55).
Received a call from management requesting we head back to HQ to let the standby guard inside.
Let the standby guard in and completed introductions; all clear, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare check on the remaining businesses open in the area, all clear. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep of the area (20:20).
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check at McDonald's, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived back at the area; commencing a 30-minute break (on break 20:45).
Night guard has arrived; awaiting the second guard's arrival and charging the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Male vagrant taking shelter outside the HQ premises successfully removed.
Afternoon shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:23 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Full sweep of Darby Street; welfare check at Mali Thai and Celine's, all clear. Arrived at Bar 101, maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Smashed Potatoes, Burger Express, Domino's, Mr Snacks and Chicken n Chips n Fish, all clear. Maintaining presence at Bar 101.
Arrived at the office; charging the phone for a short while before commencing full patrols.
Standing down from the office and heading out for patrols.
Darby Street all clear; arrived at Bar 101, maintaining presence.
Full sweep of Elliott Street; welfare checks at the Elliott Wilson Carpark, Mr Snack, Chicken n Chips n Fish, Domino's, Burger Express and Smashed Potatoes, all clear. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Victoria Street all clear; patrolling Albert Street.
Standing down from patrols — received a response call from Localito Convenience Store regarding an intoxicated male and female.

Arrived at the location; no one was inside, but we were told they had trashed the whole store. No individuals matching the description were located in the area. Standing by outside Localito as the staff member on duty was feeling unsafe.
Standing down; welfare checks all clear. Continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and Luxury Karaoke Bar, all clear, no issues. Arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep of the area (00:15).
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check with the McDonald's staff and guard and Kong Security, all clear. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour and Kemuri; maintaining presence.
Removed alcohol from a male individual drinking in public.
Welfare check at Reign & Pour and Kemuri, all clear. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Full sweep of Quay Street, all clear, no issues. Patrolling the Viaduct area for any issues (01:30–01:40).
Full sweep of the Viaduct; welfare checks with the marina guards, Rosies, Lulas and Dannys, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Full sweep of Quay Street; welfare checks at Take 10, Kemuri and with the guards, all clear.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area and maintaining presence (02:20).
Removed alcohol from a group of minors drinking in public.
Removed alcohol from a female individual drinking in public.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare check on the public presence and McDonald's and staff, all clear. Patrolling down Customs Street.
The whole of Customs Street all clear, no issues; welfare check at Customs Convenience Store, all clear. Patrolling Fort Street.

Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare checks along Gore Street, Commerce Street, Tribe Hotel, the Fort Street Wilson Carpark, The White Lady, Jo & Joes and The Right Track, all clear. Patrolling up High Street.
Welfare checks along Jean Batten Avenue, Shortland Street and Motherland, all clear. Patrolling up High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues confirmed.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place, O'Connell Street and Chancery Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, all clear, no issues confirmed. Patrolling down Victoria Street to Bar 101.
Welfare check along Victoria Street, all clear; patrolling Elliott Street.
Welfare check at Domino's and the Elliott Wilson Carpark, all clear. Arrived at Bar 101, standing by until closing (03:50).
Welfare check at Bar 101; standing by until the crowd in the area clears out.
Crowd in the area has cleared; heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone (04:30–04:40).
Charging completed; gearing up and commencing patrols.
Received a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a female vagrant inside the premises shouting and causing a customer disturbance. En route to the location.
Arrived at the location; the female vagrant was inside. Approached and kindly asked the vagrant to vacate the area; standing by until the vagrant and her belongings are off site.
The vagrant has been moved along from the area; standing by for any further issues.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street. Received a call from McDonald's Britomart in regards to a male individual inside the premises causing a disturbance. En route to the location.

Arrived at the location (05:28–05:35); the individual was still inside the premises. Got both sides of the story and understood the situation before taking action. As we were about to kindly ask the individual to vacate the premises, Police arrived on site and took the situation into their hands; we asked if assistance was needed but it was kindly declined. Heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; commencing a 30-minute break (05:50).
Night shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: SENSITIVE: 11:15 Kathmandu — a POI's associate tried to fight a civilian bystander; guards physically broke them apart and separated the two parties (photo on file); Police informed at 11:30. Physical intervention by the HOTC team — NOT Commercial Bay and NOT the Reign & Pour matter.
SENSITIVE: 18:11 Wellesley/Queen Street — male vagrant spat at and threatened to harm a member of the public; team held the scene until Police arrived and took statements; no force used by the team.
SENSITIVE: 00:41 and 01:00 routine Night Shift welfare checks at Reign & Pour (with Kemuri), all clear — no incident or use of force; noted only because of the separate Reign & Pour matter.
CAPACITY: 06:46 McDonald's Queen Street call (sleeping vagrant refusing to leave) attended at 07:15 — ~29 minutes from call to arrival.

CAPACITY: 17:32–17:37 three near-simultaneous theft calls (Albert Mart, Lovisa, plus a same-POI call) — team triaged to Lovisa as most resolvable; Albert Mart (no photo/description available) received no separate attendance.
CAPACITY: Afternoon patrols did not commence until 16:00 — second guard arrived 15:00 and the Ops Phone was on 3%, charging 15:15–16:00.

capacity.call: McDonald's Queen Street — sleeping vagrant refusing to leave

capacity.note: Three near-simultaneous theft calls 17:32–17:37; triaged to Lovisa (most resolvable); no photo/description available for Albert Mart.
